title: a settings file with the guard on only some of the slots is a warning that names the missing slot, not a failure
intent: INTENDED behavior (defect N-20). A settings file that registers the guard on PreToolUse Bash and SessionEnd but not on the orca MCP tools is incomplete. doctor prints `warn hooks: registered on PreToolUse Bash, SessionEnd only (missing PreToolUse orca MCP): run jitso setup hook` and exits 0, so a pipeline that runs doctor does not break.

stdout.regex: (?m)^warn hooks: registered on PreToolUse Bash, SessionEnd only \(missing PreToolUse orca MCP\): run jitso setup hook
